findings.what: A case-controlled promotion journal can delete arbitrary regular files or directories inside the case during public resume recovery.
findings.why: run_workflow calls recover_interrupted_promotion after the whole-tree scan, but _read_journal validates only schema_version, relative path syntax, and the phase/attempt spelling. It does not bind entries to the fixed phase write set or validate each entry's original/status transition. A portable case can supply a regular .anomaly/promotion.json with an unsealed P0-P7 attempt, an entry such as {"path":"README.md","original":false,"status":"applied"}, and no backup. _rollback then reaches discard_workspace(live) and removes README.md before rewinding state. The same path can target data/raw, instructions, or other in-case evidence, making this reachable case-data loss rather than a path-escape false positive.

findings.what: The shared durable-error sanitizer misses standard compound credential assignments such as AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY.
findings.why: _SECRET_ASSIGNMENT requires a word boundary immediately before api_key, secret, or token. In environment-style names the preceding underscore is a word character, so the match never starts; _TOKEN_PREFIX catches only a small prefix list. The direct probe returned AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=abcdEFGHijklMNOPqrstUVWXyz0123456789ABCD unchanged. A dynamic P5/P6 owner exception containing that standard configuration spelling flows through safe_error into failure.json, events.jsonl, state.failures, and blocked_reason for all three attempts. The recovered test covers an AKIA-prefixed access-key ID labeled only aws=, not an AWS secret-access-key assignment, so durable secret exposure remains reachable.

evidence.output: Scanner covered 25 src/anomaly files, reported six high regex hits, two coverage gaps, zero audit-tool failures, and REVIEW. The six hits were one ast.literal_eval and five interpolated DuckDB statements; GitHub Actions and XSS were the two scanner gaps.

All six machine hits are refuted as exploits. ast.literal_eval parses only quoted scalar literals and cannot execute code. Detector memory_mb and threads are type-checked positive integers before interpolation. Prepared table IDs are generated as tbl_ plus a SHA-256 hex digest and view names come from enumerate. Profile table IDs must match tbl_[0-9a-f]{64} before interpolation. Detector SQL is fixed package-owned SELECT-only text, rejects comments, extra statements, mutating words, implicit file relations, and external reader functions; DuckDB opens the index read-only with external access disabled.

Public dispatch scans through resume_case and then immediately invokes recovery. Recovery accepts journal-controlled relative entries without binding them to _OWNER_REGISTRY writes. For every non-pending entry, rollback restores a backup when present, otherwise deletes the live target whenever journal.original is false. The parser does not validate original/status fields or require a genuine backup/workspace, confirming the crafted-journal deletion path.
